info.title: easyVerein REST-API documentation
info.description:
This version is the latest version, you can use the alias latest

General overview

This API provides you with access to data and routines of the easyVerein software and allows you to integrate easyVerein into other tools and services. You may access and update information stored in easyVerein using this API or invoke procedures of this software. You may use this API to build your custom workflows, exchange data with tools or extend the functionality of the software. Requests are limited to 100/min.

Responsibility

Please read the instructions carefully. Be aware that we cannot take any responsibility when you alter, disclose or delete any data unintentionally. Any API call authenticated with your API token is taken as a data processing instruction of your organization. §3 and §4 of our data processing agreement (AVV) also applies to instructions given by using the API. This also applies when you call API endpoints by using scripts, third-party applications, external tools or other software solutions.

Support

Please note that our customer support team cannot provide you with support for our API services. If you have questions regarding this API that are not covered by our documentation our support team may forward your request to our technical team but please be aware that it might take longer than usual to get a response. Our technical team cannot check or verify your implementations and scripts. We cannot provide you with support for custom software or third-party applications.

Authentication

To use this API you need to transfer a token for every request within the header. To do so you need to set a header variable like this: 'Authorization': 'Bearer <YOUR-API-KEY>'.

Since v2.0 the tokens are valid for 30 days. 15 days after the creation/refresh of a token the token should be refreshed (replaced by a new one) using the refresh-token endpoint

The API will inform you that your token needs to be refreshed by setting the tokenRefreshNeeded attribute in every header of every response. A simple GET request on the refresh-token endpoint will give you a new token that replaces the old token immediately. v2.0 will enforce the use of this token.

Applications

An application is also a normal member but with the _isApplication flag set to true. To make a new application we strongly recommend to send the applications data to your backend and send them from there to the API using the token of the organization. We also recommend the use of any spam prevention like the reCaptcha.

Good to know

The member- and the contact-details- table needs each other, if you plan to create a user, please do it like this: First create a contact-details (POST to the contact-details endpoint) and enter at least all required fields. The fields that are required depends on the '_isCompany' attribute. If it is set to "true", 'companyName' is the only field you have to define. If it is set to "false" (which is the default), you need to define at least the 'firstName' and the 'familyName'. After you have successfully created the contact details, you can create a member. The required fields for the member are: 'emailOrUserName' and 'contactDetails'. If you set '_isApplication' to "true" you automatically create a membership application which can be manually reviewed within the software. We recommend to do so if you build your own application form. Please note: The relationship of contactDetails to member is a composition, the member requires the contactDetails, the contactDetails can exist without a member.

You can reference to the contact-details-endpoint (and any other relation) in three ways:

  1. With a string, containing the http-reference like the API shows the relation (for example https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/contact-details/{pk})
  2. With a string, containing the primary key (pk) of the reference
  3. With an integer as the primary key (pk) of the reference

It is highly recommended to use the ?query term if possible. The API will optimize the performance depending on the queried data. So please consider that the API can be faster if you limit the fields to get.

It is also possible to define the amount of entries to view per page using the ?limit term. The default value of it is 5 and the maximum value is 100

What about this bulk-endpoints?

The bulk-update and bulk-create endpoints can include multiple requests for the same endpoint. It is possible to use these endpoints to create or change a big amount of entries in just one single request.

This is much more time saving and even energy efficient than doing a single request per entry.

We recommend to use these endpoints when possible to improve performance, saving energy and time.

Why doesn't each endpoint have a bulk endpoint?

It is theoretically possible to activate this for every endpoint. For now the bulks are just active for:member,contact-details,invoice,event,booking,lending,application-form-element,organization-token,^member/(?P<userPk>(\d+))/custom-fields,^contact-details/(?P<contactDetailsPk>(\d+))/custom-fields,^event/(?P<eventPk>(\d+))/custom-fields,^inventory-object/(?P<inventoryObjectPk>(\d+))/custom-fields,^member/(?P<userPk>(\d+))/groups,^custom-field/(?P<customFieldPk>(\d+))/select-options,participation-price-group,

We just think that the bulk actions are not usefully for every endpoint.

How to upload a file? (e.g. _profilePicture)

Uploading a file isn't possible for POST requests. It is possible to PATCH files though. Uploading with a PATCH just works like a normal PATCH but with a special header set:

'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; name="samplename"; filename="samplepicture.jpg"'

The body of the PATCH includes the key of the field to upload the file for (e.g. _profilePicture) and a byte stream as value.

Samples

For further examples on how this API works, please take a look on our REST-API-Samples hosted on GitLab.

There is also an inofficial Node.js library and some actively developed projects (for example a Discord Bot and a custom payment page) on GitHub! Thanks to Fensterbank for sharing his implementations!

The API has also an unofficial (community) python library now!


A good sample for a get request with nested query:

Request:

https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/member?query={id,contactDetails{id,name},org{id,name,short},emailOrUserName,membershipNumber}

Response:

	
		{
			"membershipNumber": "",
			"org": {
				"id": ,
				"short": "",
				"name": ""
			}, 
			"id": , 
			"contactDetails": {
				"id": ,
				"name": ""
			},
			"emailOrUserName": ""
		}

Request:

https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/contact-details?query={id,customFields{addressObject{customFields{addressObject{id}}}}}

Response:

	
		{
			"id": ,
			"customFields": [{
				"addressObject": {
					"customFields": "https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/contact-details//custom-fields/"
				}
			}]
		}

There is a recursion limit for the API to prevent the same entry from being retrieved again in a request.

Request:

https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/member?query={id,customFields{-org,-userObject,-_deleteAfterDate,-_deletedBy}}

Response:

	
		{
			"id": ,
			"customFields": [{
				"id": ,
				"customField": "https://easyverein.com/api/v2.0/custom-field/",
				"value": ""
			}]
		}

It is also possible to define a negative query to exclude some fields from a response, this can be helpfully if a request needs most of the fields but does not need all. This is made possible by putting a '-' in front of the field: ?query={-$field}

Changelog:

Endpoints:

  • normalize:

  • POST: Added normalization support for the debitName field (SEPA-compliant formatting).

  • location:

  • PATCH: The longlat attribute gets updated when updating the location

  • [New] chat-settings

  • GET/PATCH: The new chat-settings endpoint allows to update the users preferences for the chat feature.

  • [New] chat-actions

  • GET: This endpoint is used for pre-Matrix preparations of clients.

  • ALL: The new endpoint allows to setup OAuth2 applications.

  • GET: Applications now contain the read-only field public.

  • [New] oauth2-custom-claim:

  • ALL: Setup the new custom claims which allow applications to access specific custom fields of the user

  • [New] oauth-credentials:

  • GET/PATCH: oauthcredentials are now available to get by their id and their details field is updatable.

  • ALL: added SmtpEmailSetting used to define from which smtp email profile mails should be sent from (formerly saved directly on the user). One OrgUser can have up to three SmtpEmailSettings.
  • GET: The field gmailoauthcredentials is now called oauthcredentials

  • PATCH: New action to set the password: update-password

  • [New] anniversary-mailing:

  • ALL: Create, update and delete anniversary mailing objects which are used to store information on what mails should be sent on which anniversaries (e.g. birthdays and jubilees)

  • refresh-token

  • GET: The new field expiresIn tells you how long the refresh-token is valid.

  • GET: Removed the logging to avoid customer confusion

  • announcement:

  • GET: Added a field icsLink containing the link for the ics of the protocol

  • GET: uid is now an empty string instead of None when it is not set

  • protocol-element:

  • POST: The field text is no longer required.

  • GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE: Every chairman can now interact with this endpoint

  • inventory-object:

  • POST/PATCH: All members, not only administrators, can be set as being responsible for an inventory object (lendingResponsible)
  • GET: Added new filter futureReturnDate to obtain all lendings whose returnDate is in the future or not set
  • GET: Make lastLendDate and lastReturnDate available in the current version of the API
  • GET: Added the new filter showReminders to filter for entries linked to a reminder customfield and to reduce the customFields-references to the reminders
  • GET: Fixed a bug causing a crash when using the query parameter customFields{*}
  • PATCH: The number of pieces can now be set to 0
  • PATCH/POST: Log group assignment changes in the changelog
  • GET/PATCH/POST: [breaking] Added a new endpoint inventory-object/$id/custom-fields/$customFieldId/select-options representing chosen options for select fields (custom fields with settings_type a and s). For these fields selectedOptions replaces the value attribute

  • GET: [breaking] The field customFields is now always a list

  • lending:

  • GET/POST/PATCH: [breaking] replaced borrowMember with borrowAddress
  • POST: lending emails will now contain more details
  • PATCH: The quantity cannot be set to 0 anymore
  • GET: Added ordering by parentInventoryObject__name and parentInventoryObject__description

  • GET: Added the following fields to search for: parentInventoryObject__name, parentInventoryObject__description, parentInventoryObject__identifier, parentInventoryObject__locationName, parentInventoryObject__locationObject__name, returnDate, borrowingDate, quantity

  • [New] article-object:

  • ALL: Added the new endpoint for article objects used for invoices
  • ALL: Added the new field sphere to this endpoint
  • PATCH: Fixed that additional is only validated when it is given
  • POST: Made the identifier optional, setting its value automatically if it is not set
  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added the field billingAccount to this endpoint

  • ALL: Chairmen with inventory permissions can create/change entries

  • custom-field:

  • GET: Normal users can now see the collection cross-connection from a customfield entry.
  • ALL: Added the new field sphere to this endpoint
  • POST/PATCH: The name of a customfield must be unique

  • GET/PATCH/POST: [breaking] Added a new endpoint custom-field/$id/select-options representing options for select fields (custom fields with settings_type a and s). For these fields selectOptions replaces the additional attribute

  • booking:

  • POST/PATCH: Changed that bookingProject must not be completed to link it to a booking
  • ALL: Added the new field sphere to this endpoint
  • POST/PATCH: Considering the bookkeepingStandardFormOfAccountsEnabled setting now
  • PATCH/DELETE: Considering the bookkeepingLockCommitDate setting now
  • POST/PATCH: Log booking project and bank account assignment changes in the changelog

  • POST/PATCH: relatedInvoice needs to be invoices that have "invoice" as mode and cannot have isDraft, isTemplate or isRequest set to True

  • booking-project:

  • POST/PATCH: Changed that short must be unique
  • PATCH/DELETE: Enabled the wastebasket restoring/deleting
  • GET: Searching for short and name is now possible

  • POST/PATCH: subOrg can not be set for demo organizations

  • bank-account:

  • POST/PATCH: Changed that short must be unique
  • ALL: Added the new field sphere to this endpoint
  • PATCH/DELETE: Enabled the wastebasket restoring/deleting
  • POST/PATCH: Changed the max length from BIC to 11

  • ALL: Added the new field last_imported_date to this endpoint

  • [New] check-discount-code:

  • POST: Added the new endpoint to check if the given discount-code is valid or not

  • POST: Added the field discount to the response to inform about the discount in percent

  • invoice:

  • GET: Fixed that charges will no longer hit the database more times than needed, causing a little overhead
  • PATCH: Fixed the wastebasket restoring
  • POST: Preventing the user from canceling a cancellation-invoice
  • ALL: Add fields creationDateForRecurringInvoices and recurringInvoicesInterval
  • PATCH: Fixed a bug where relatedAddress was not valid when the requesting chairman had no permissions to see the ALREADY set relatedAddress
  • GET: Fixed the paymentDifference-condition in _isOpenForBookingFilter
  • GET/PATCH: Considering the memberAreaShowInvoices setting for members
  • PATCH/DELETE: Considering the bookkeepingLockCommitDate setting now
  • GET: Made the counter-field from canceledInvoice visible named cancelInvoice which points to the invoice that is canceling it
  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added new field customPaymentMethod
  • POST: Fixed a crash when posting isReceipt=True and no relatedAddress with a organization token
  • POST: Fixed a crash when posting isRequest=True and receiver is set and no relatedAddress is set with a organization token
  • GET: Add ne filter option for kind field
  • GET/PATCH/POST: Added new field isReceipt
  • PATCH/POST: Made field invoiceItems required for any invoice that is not a draft (isDraft), a template (isTemplate) or a request (isRequest)
  • DELETE: Invoices that are not deletable cannot be deleted anymore
  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added new fields _isTaxRatePerInvoiceItem and _isSubjectToTax
  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added new field closingDescription
  • GET: Searching for date is now possible
  • POST/PATCH: relatedBookings and canceledInvoice can only be set when mode is "invoice"
  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added the new field useAddressBalance that determine if possible credit balances should be included in the calculation

  • GET/POST/PATCH: Added the new field participationPriceGroups that links the invoice to multiple entries of the participation-price-group endpoint

  • invoice-item:

  • GET/POST/PATCH: [breaking] Renamed the field article to articleObject

  • invoice-item:

  • POST/PATCH: The field title does not allow None as value anymore and the max_length of title is increased from 200 to 300

  • [New] payment-method:

  • ALL: Added the new endpoint for methods of payment used for invoices and addresses
  • POST: Fixed a bug where payedFromUser was not set when the requesting user is a chairman and the field is not set in the request

  • PATCH: The relatedAddress will not be set automatically when isTemplate=True

  • [New] cancellation:

  • POST: It is now possible to make a cancellation even as not authenticated user

  • task:

  • POST: starttime and endtime are no longer mandatory when parentEvent is given
  • PATCH: Fixed that name is no longer required for patches
  • PATCH: Fixed the wastebasket restoring

  • PATCH/POST: Log calendar assignment changes in the changelog

  • [New] community-function-feedback:

  • POST/GET/DELETE: Added a new endpoint to send feedback for certain functions in easyVerein

  • forum:

  • ALL: Chairmen now need the forum module permissions for this endpoint
  • GET/PATCH/POST: Added the new field order to make forums sortable for an organization

  • GET: Made the endpoint faster

  • topic:

  • ALL: Chairmen now need the forum module permissions for this endpoint
  • POST: Subscribers of a forum will now get email notifications when a new topic is created
  • GET: Added the filter subscribed to show only the topics that the requesting user is subscribed to
  • POST/PATCH: Fixed that chairmen can change their own type and other fields that chairmen are allowed to change
  • GET: Made the endpoint faster
  • GET: Fixed a bug where posts could occur more than once in the response and where requesting a single topic caused an error
  • GET: Incrementing the views_count of a topic on retrieve

  • GET: New action report returns the reportUrl which can be used to report the given topic.

  • post:

  • ALL: Chairmen now need the forum module permissions for this endpoint
  • POST: Subscribers of a topic will new get email notifications when a new post is created
  • PATCH: updates_count now gets incremented by the API
  • GET: Removed some fields from the endpoint: anonymous_key, update_reason, updated_by, username, enable_signature
  • GET: Made the endpoint faster
  • GET: Fixed a bug where posts could occur more than once in the response

  • GET: New action report returns the reportUrl which can be used to report the given post.

  • billing-account:

  • ALL: Added the new field defaultSphere to this endpoint

  • [New] application-form:

  • ALL: Implemented the application forms in the API
  • GET/PATCH/POST: Added the new field confirmButtonText that contains the text for the confirm button for the application
  • GET: Added new filter showOwn to filter only forms beloging to one's own organization

  • GET/PATCH/DELETE: Enabled the wastebasket for this endpoint

  • [New] application-form-element:

  • ALL: Implemented the application forms in the API, application form elements are the individual fields that can be filled

  • POST/PATCH: Enabled this endpoint for bulk-update and bulk-create

  • [New] apply:

  • POST: Implemented the new apply endpoint to enable external (anonymous) users to register to an organization. This endpoint needs a reference to a applicationForm and will require all mandatory fields of the applicationForm and only allows fields that are in the applicationForm

  • [New] lsb-sport:

  • ALL: Added the new endpoint for lsb-sports

  • statistics:

  • GET: Made the endpoint smart and respect the query parameter to save performance

  • feature-request:

  • GET: Drastically improved the performance for simple get requests

  • GET: The status of a feature request will now change automatically to 1 ("In Pruefung") when the score of the request reaches 50+

  • get-token:

  • GET: Fixed broken login log status

  • price-group:

    • GET/POST/PATCH: [breaking] Renamed the field copiedFrom to original
    • GET/POST/PATCH: [breaking] Renamed the field price to sellingPrice
    • GET: Added the new read only field availablePieces
    • GET/POST/PATCH: Added the new fields billingAccount, hasUnlimitedPieces, pieces, reservedPieces, taxRate, taxName, custCentre, sphere, gross and maximumPiecesPerParticipation
    • POST: Added a new action generate-invoices to generate invoices for all participation price groups related to a price group
    • GET: Normal members can now also see the field maximumPiecesPerParticipation

  • [New] participation-price-group:

  • ALL: Added the new endpoint participation-price-group. This endpoint links multiple participations to multiple price groups.

All endpoints:

  • ALL: All endpoints except for get-token, refresh-token and statistics can only be used, using the new expiring tokens
  • GET: Fixed a prefetch error causing the API to produce a overhead on certain queries
  • GET/PATCH: Enabled the wastebasket for every endpoint that has the _deleteAfterDate and _deletedBy attributes
  • GET: Removed the verbose_names and descriptions from each endpoint since it is bloat. Every normal endpoint now has a descriptions action to obtain this information
  • GET: [breaking] Hiding the count parameter by default improving the performance on large organizations with large query results significantly. Adding the parameter showCount=true to the request will include this parameter again in the response
  • GET: Fixed a rare edgecase where for example {*,contactDetails{customFields{*}}} would crash the api. The same key can now be considered in the same query multible times

Generic:

  • Changed that mass actions can now handle a new given attribute: ids instead of filters. This makes it possible to select the entries to change by hand
  • It is no longer possible to referer to an entry in the wastebasket
  • The system treats get-token logins now like web logins
  • Logins with QR Codes are now logged correctly.
  • POST: Fixed that chairmen with only read permissions on members/addresses can set the corresponding entries again

Documentation:

  • Describing the new token authentication
  • Improved the description of the get-token Endpoint
  • Fixed a rare bug occurring when the first customfield of a requesting user is a multiline customfield
  • Added a body for the session-filter documentation
  • Fixed the documentation description for custom-fields sub endpoints

patch.summary:
Update invoice (and optional items) atomically.

provided invoiceItems. Items with an `id` will be updated, items
without an `id` will be created, and items containing `delete`: True
will be deleted. The whole operation is wrapped in a transaction so
any validation error rolls back and yields a 400 response. Permission
is denied if the caller lacks chairman booking write permission.

post.description: Getting the token for the user to authenticate himself to use the api. This endpoint needs the login data of the user. Please consider, that `username` is build like this: `$orgShort_$emailOrUsername`. So if your orgshort is for example "abc" and your username is "some@example.de" the username string to use for authentication is `abc_some@example.de`.
post.summary: Get the token for a user to authenticate
